name: vlm_actin_stress_fiber_abundance
description: Visually scores the abundance of actin stress fibers. High values indicate numerous thick, parallel contractile fibers; low values correspond to cortical or diffuse actin without prominent stress fibers.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells using the Actin channel.
method_rationale: Evaluating the 'prominence' or 'organization' of fibers is a subjective visual task that VLMs can perform consistently.
